title: Park repositories instead of disposing them
summary: Switching repositories threw the one you left away, so going back read it all again. Now it is parked: its handle and reads stay, they answer at once, and only the open one takes writes.

slides.title: Leaving a repository keeps its handle alive
slides.lede: Going back returns the same handle, its lists already read; get() reads a repository without selecting it.

before.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  O["open(B)"] --> D["dispose A: caches, watchers, rows"]
  D --> N[new handle for B]
before.caption: One live handle; the old one is disposed

after.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  O["open(B)"] --> M[handles map]
  M --> S[B selected]
  M --> P["A parked: discovery off, data kept"]
  G["get(C)"] --> M
after.caption: Every handle kept for the life of the process

slides.title: A parked repository answers at once from what it holds
slides.lede: Within an hour it reads nothing; past it, it still answers and reads behind; with nothing held, it reads and waits.
slides.body: One rule, `parkedWarm`, applied in the review read lane, the worktree service and the pull request list (`refreshInBackground` with a `maxAge`). A failed refresh behind a parked read still answers with the data; the error stays in the snapshot.

visual.caption: The selected repository keeps each resource's own TTL

slides.title: Reads go anywhere; writes only to the selected repository
slides.lede: A parked handle refuses every write before any work, and review writes check again after their awaits.
slides.body:
- Config writes, worktree create, remove, rebase and fetch: `assertSelected`.
- Review replies, resolutions, submissions, drafts, mentions and agent findings: `selected()`, then `assertWritable()` before the provider is asked.
- Diff reads refuse only a request naming another repository (`other-repo`).

slides.title: Parking stops observation and drops only diff patches
slides.lede: Discovery stops and patches (up to 64 MiB each) are released; the pull request list never evicts a list a repository shows.
slides.body: Manifests, listings and the live checkout diff (still a one-second TTL) stay. Past `MAX_CACHED_SCOPES`, only scopes a config change left behind are dropped.

slides.title: Look closely: patches can outlive parking
slides.lede: One suspected problem and one question; the unbounded handle set is by design.
slides.body:
**Suspected:** patches read through a `get()` handle, or still loading at park time, are never released.

**Question:** `get()` runs config auto-detection, which can write to disk for an unopened repository.

**Nit:** two refusal messages for one rule.

**By design:** handles and shown PR lists are kept for the process's life.

**Not verified:** tests not run; the follow-up PRs' callers.
